definition_record.definition: The pinned STEM helper averages transformed correctness, detectability, and a relative-perplexity component named naturalness in that code. The final 2026 paper calls its third criterion imperceptibility.
definition_record.replay_mapping: No numeric STEM score is produced because the required model-based perplexity inputs are absent. Human naturalness is a separate interpretation dimension of this study; source similarity or human ratings do not substitute for the missing component.

imported_definition: Pinned STEM helper equal-weight average with a relative-perplexity component (legacy variable naturalness)
reason_full_system_not_executed: Requires model generation and a perplexity component absent from the declared automatic construct boundary
final_paper_metric_note: Final EACL2026 §3.2 uses correctness, detectability and perplexity-based imperceptibility with configurable weights. The helper and paper version are identified separately.
